$comment: NIP-ME promotion-validator conformance fixtures — negative-cases-first shared oracle for the engine-side typed promotion validator. Unlike NIP-MP.fixtures.json (unsigned relay-ingest templates), these cases evaluate a promotion DECISION: the validator receives an admitted kind:40200 proposal, the reviewer's kind:40203 verdict with its proof bundle, the promotion-granting NIP-SD v3 keyed proofs, and engine state (generation, admission time, frozen policy snapshot), and MUST produce exactly the `expect` outcome. `expect` values: reject (the promotion is refused with a loud error naming one of `reject_rules`), no_promotion_authorized (fail-closed to human review across the whole grant set — validator authorizes nothing but is not a single-event error), remains_review (no proof exists; the item never left review — not an error), promote (governed promotion event minted; receipt labels asserted). Spec: docs/nips/NIP-ME.md (Delegated review verdicts, Promotion policy and receipts); grant shapes: docs/nips/NIP-SD.md (v3 payload).

cases.name: reject_copied_proof
cases.note: Evidence produced and signed by the proposer, pasted into the verdict. Producer-bound means the reviewer signs its own evidence after admission; proposer-supplied evidence is the laundering path.

cases.name: reject_proof_predates_admission
cases.note: Valid-looking reviewer evidence whose signature predates the proposal's admission time — it cannot have been produced for this item.

cases.name: reject_unbound_verifier
cases.note: The proof bundle's bound_verifier is another_reviewer while the verdict is signed by reviewer. The bundle must bind the promoting key itself.

cases.name: reject_stale_generation
cases.note: The approve was evaluated at generation G; the engine generation advanced within the claim's dependency set before execution. Reject to re-verification at head — never queue, never warn.

cases.name: reject_promoter_equals_proposer
cases.note: Approve key equals the proposing key. Protocol MUST: an actor's own approval never satisfies review.

cases.name: reject_route_to_nobody
cases.note: Policy routes review but the resolved reviewer set is empty. Loud rejection at admission, never a void item nobody owns.

cases.name: reject_v3_aggregate_shape
cases.note: A proof carrying version:3 in the v2 aggregate shape (per-capability subjects, no granteePubkey). Known version, unknown document: fails validation loud, same as an unknown version.

cases.name: reject_memory_promotion_boolean_true
cases.note: memory_promotion granted as bare true. Granting without naming claim types is not a shape its author can have meant; fail loud, never interpret as unrestricted.

cases.name: reject_claim_type_outside_vocabulary
cases.note: claimTypes includes identity_mapping — outside the delegable vocabulary. Fail loud rather than narrowing to the known subset: a reader that silently ignored an unrecognized claim type would widen the grant.

cases.name: reject_empty_claim_types
cases.note: claimTypes is []. An empty grant is an authoring error, not a silent none.

cases.name: reject_allowlist_on_non_granting_proof
cases.note: humanFallbackAllowlist carried by a keyed proof whose memory_promotion is false/absent. The field exists only on granting proofs; this needs an explicit deny check, not serde defaults.

cases.name: no_promotion_disagreeing_allowlists
cases.note: Two keyed proofs both granting memory_promotion with differing humanFallbackAllowlist values (restored-backup / partial-write shape). Fail closed to human review: no promotion is authorized by any of them.

cases.name: remains_review_no_probe
cases.note: fact_proposal with no registered probe. The reviewer cannot verify, and absence of a valid proof means the item never leaves review — structural default, not an error and not an escalation requirement.

cases.name: promote_valid_delegated_verdict
cases.note: Positive control: current generation, promoter != proposer, reviewer-owned post-admission evidence bound to the 40200 payload hash, valid v3 keyed grant, allowlist agrees. Receipt must carry authority=delegated_agent, verification_class=reproduced_by_promoter, reproducible_by=privileged.
